pinnedFiles.reason: Primary spec source for the two criteria this order covers (AC1: all eight sites shown within 1 km, listed by name; AC2: pole/180th-meridian sites shown once, correctly). Also carries the seed data table (eight sites with lat/lng) and the settled gate answers (1 km tolerance, Aurelis is a 6,000 km sphere) the analyst needs to restate.

The Gherkin scenarios for AC1/AC2 in business language -- the AC-to-scenario traceability the analyst must preserve. The other four .feature files in this directory belong to the next three orders and are excluded per the spec's Out of Scope section.

Defines the seam contract this order must implement verbatim: window.__SATURDAY_CESIUM__ = { viewer, Cesium }, and saturdayMetadata (id, name, kind) on every site entity. This is the context crossing into the Test Automation bounded context the spec explicitly names -- only the public-interface doc is pinned, not the package's internal source.

Concrete, already-reviewed reference implementation of the exact Cesium Viewer configuration AC2 demands: an Ellipsoid sized to a 6,000 km radius, baseLayerPicker/geocoder/ion off, a local SingleTileImageryProvider image, and the saturdayMetadata-tagged entity pattern. Saves the analyst from re-deriving the Cesium option list from scratch.

The existing GET /api/reagent-sites handler (around lines 127-129) and its data loading (around lines 11-26, 342-352) -- the API contract the view consumes. No backend change is in scope for this order, so the analyst only needs to document it.
The actual seed data, including the two edge-case sites named in AC2 by id: frostcap-hollow (lat 85, near the north pole) and tidewrack-shoals (lng 180, on the meridian).

The only existing map view in this app (Leaflet-based) -- the established pattern for lifecycle, exposing a window seam for Playwright, and attaching metadata to markers. The new reagent map view is a sibling of this file, adapted to Cesium's seam contract.
The file the new /reagent-map route (and its feature-flag gate) must be added to; shows the existing route list so the analyst can describe the change as additive.

Already has the 'chrome' project (real Chrome, software WebGL) that the spec requires reagent-map-*.spec.ts to run under, and shows that the default chromium project must stay unaffected -- needed for the test-approach/DoD criteria.
Confirms no VITE_FEATURE_REAGENT_MAP entry exists yet; AC1 requires this file to set it to false.
